question.text: The option writer (seller) of a put option has:

answer.text: An obligation to buy from the put buyer if the option is exercised
The right to buy at the strike price
An obligation to sell at the strike price
No obligation as premium has been received

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook's call/put buyer-seller rights and obligations table, the put seller receives the premium and in return has the obligation to buy from the put buyer at the strike price if the option is exercised. The Trap: The put buyer has the right to sell. The call seller has the obligation to sell. Receiving premium creates the obligation - it does not extinguish it. Note: Only buyers hold rights; sellers always carry obligations in exchange for the upfront premium under the workbook's framework.
